location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

baked.description: False: the run installs it from the registry at start and caches it nowhere

match_urls.description: Upstream URLs as repository files write them

repos.description: Kind github: owner/name of the readable repositories

image.description: Image reference with a tag or digest

env.description: Name of an environment variable of the API process.

value.description: New value. The API never returns it.

execution.description: Off: no stage runs a command or writes a file

preview.description: What Sayso posts, rendered as Markdown; shadow mode posts nothing

allow_tools.description: Name patterns of write tools to allow; needs allow_write

secret_header.description: Header that carries the secret value

agent_key.description: skills:read, sets:read and events:write; it reaches agent runs

reporter_key.description: events:write and outcomes:write; it never leaves the API

budget_spent.description: The monthly budget is spent; no new round starts
